modules.responsibility: process entrypoint, listener configuration, graceful shutdown
HTTP routing, JSON boundaries, status mapping
workflow orchestration and execution token issuance
mutex-protected in-memory persistence and atomic updates
request, response, and stable error contracts

workflows.name: Register gate
steps: decode and validate the public request
persist the gate without replacing an existing identifier
workflows.success: returns the created gate with idle status
workflows.failure: returns stable invalid input or duplicate identifier errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a gate and reads it through GET /gates/{id}

workflows.name: Request gate command
steps: validate target aperture and request fields
persist a pending command with the starting aperture snapshot
workflows.success: returns a pending command that references the current gate state
workflows.failure: returns not found for an unknown gate and invalid input for out-of-range data
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a gate, submits a command, and reads the pending command

workflows.name: Review safety interlock
steps: transition the command according to the verdict
reserve the gate and issue an execution token only for a clear decision
workflows.success: returns an approved command and one execution token
workflows.failure: returns a stable conflict when another command already owns the gate
workflows.verification: workflowcheck clears one command and proves a second clear review cannot reserve the same gate

workflows.name: Execute gate command
steps: validate the command, gate reservation, and one-time token
apply approved to executing to terminal command transitions
settle the gate aperture and release the active command reference atomically
workflows.success: returns a completed command and an idle gate at the target aperture
workflows.failure: returns conflict for an invalid or reused token; a simulated fault aborts the command and latches the gate in faulted status
workflows.verification: workflowcheck executes a reviewed command, confirms the new aperture, and proves token reuse is rejected

workflows.name: Per-gate review queue and priority adjustment
steps: auto-enqueue every new pending command at its gate's queue tail
order entries by priority then FIFO sequence and expose the current head
gate reviews on the real current head, dequeue it on commit, and recompute the next head from commands still genuinely pending
append-only priority adjustments with a recorded basis and duplicate-enqueue rejection
workflows.success: returns queue order, priority basis history and the current head; only the head can enter review and the next item advances after head completion
workflows.failure: non-head, concurrent, duplicate-enqueue, post-state-change, and invalid-priority attempts return stable conflicts or validation errors without rewriting facts
workflows.verification: workflowcheck reads the queue, reprioritizes commands, proves non-head and duplicate-enqueue conflicts, works through two heads, and verifies advancement and immutable history; unit tests add a concurrent single-winner check

complexity.notes: Gate reservation and command transitions are committed under one repository lock; execution tokens are single-command resources and become invalid after a terminal transition.
